sections.title: Background and presenting situation
sections.instruction: Who was present, the person's circumstances and why the assessment is happening.

sections.title: Needs and daily living
sections.instruction: Mobility, falls, personal care, meals, medication, continence, home environment, social contact: what the person can and cannot do, and the impact on them.

sections.title: Person's views and wishes
sections.instruction: What matters to the person, in their own words where possible. Keep family members' views separate and attributed.

sections.title: Risks and safeguarding
sections.instruction: Risks, concerns and any disclosures of harm or abuse, recorded accurately and without softening, including what was denied and what is uncertain or second-hand.

sections.title: Support network and finances
sections.instruction: Family, friends, carers and services involved; financial situation as described.

sections.title: Agreed actions
sections.instruction: Each next step with who will do it and by when, where stated.
